text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means goals should be Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Once the main goal is set, it helps to break it down into smaller milestones. These are key checkpoints that show you are making progress. You also need to define your deliverables — the actual products or results you must complete. Finally, make sure all stakeholders agree on the goals from the start. When everyone shares the same understanding, the project is much more likely to succeed.
